title: AERO9500 Report Marking Rubric (Assignment Part 2)

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Addresses all required info (primary mission, need, number of spacecraft and why, users/operators/customers) to high standard with detailed descriptions and appropriate literature references.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Addresses some requirements. Descriptions lack specific details and/or referencing is incomplete.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: Many or all requirements not addressed. Poor descriptions and lack of appropriate referencing.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Demonstrates high-level understanding of design procedure, clearly addresses mission and course concepts. All major requirements (launch site/vehicle and rationale, orbit type/characteristics/elements, maneuvers, ground facilities, communication frequency, mission duration and EOL plan) well supported with quality evidence (screenshots, software files, hand calculations, literature). Comprehensive, accurate, persuasive.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Demonstrates adequate understanding but design may be inconsistent, unclear, or contain errors. Major requirements addressed but lacking detail or evidence. Content not fully comprehensive or persuasive.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: Demonstrates minimal understanding. Major requirements not addressed and/or lack evidence. Content incomplete and not persuasive.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Detailed and appropriate conclusions drawn from report evidence.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Some conclusions reached but generic or lacking specific detail.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: No actual or useful conclusions reached.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Clear logical engineering report structure, easy to read, good writing/spelling/grammar/style, consistent formatting, concise executive summary/abstract, appropriate clear consistent figures/tables, references in text match list and properly cited.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Not professional level but uses headings/subheadings. Readable but flawed writing/spelling/grammar/style. Figures/tables labelled but formatting unclear/inconsistent affecting context. References mostly correct and match list.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: Poorly structured, incoherent, lacks understanding of section purpose. Difficult to read, poor writing with many spelling/grammar errors and inappropriate style. Presentation impedes reading due to inconsistent formatting and unlabelled figures/tables. References not cited or inconsistent.

notes: Assignment Part 2 accounts for 25% of course grade.
